style.base: Art direction (shared by every SahiSize image): clean modern flat illustration with a soft 3D feel - rounded shapes, subtle gradients, gentle soft shadows, crisp edges, calm studio lighting. 'Clear Desk' palette only: very light blue-white background #F8FAFF, deep indigo #4338CA as the main colour with lighter indigo tints, warm saffron #F59E0B as the accent colour, white and soft slate-grey neutrals. Generous empty space, one clear focal point, uncluttered and friendly, suitable for a fast mobile web page for Indian exam applicants. Any people are stylised illustrated Indian students or job candidates (mixed genders and skin tones, everyday Indian clothing), clearly drawn characters and never photographs.
style.avoid: Strict constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, digits, words, captions, labels, watermarks or signatures that can be read anywhere in the image (use blank bars or abstract lines where text would be). No real logos, emblems, flags, seals, stamps, government or exam-body branding, brand names, real app or website interfaces. No real or famous people and no photorealistic human faces. Correct anatomy, five fingers per hand. No dark or neon backgrounds, no clutter, no borders or frames around the whole image.
